ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  February 11, 2020
  AGENDA
  REGULAR MEETING - 7:30 P.M.
  Lobby Area
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street

CALL MEETING TO ORDER:

ROLL CALL:
CHRISTINE OLSON, President
RICHARD SANCHEZ, Vice President
STEVEN CHEN, Member
KATIE CHIU, Member
ANKIT UDANI, Member
RICHARD ABE, Secretary

DISCUSSION ITEMS:

1.  1501 South Raymond Avenue
This is an application for a 120 square foot one-story addition, new front porch and
exterior alterations to an existing single-family residence.
Applicant: Nathan Gallardo

Recommended Action: APPROVAL - Recommendation is for approval with the following
conditions: 1. Single hung windows shall be used throughout; 2. The window schedule
and plans shall be revised to accurately reflect window types; 3. Window details shall be
consistent with a Craftsman style of architecture; and 4. Revised drawings shall be
reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to plan check submittal.

2.  325 East Valley Boulevard
This is an application for new signage to an existing commercial building for the business
known as “Preferred Bank.”
Applicant: Eddie Hsieh, Sign Art Co.

Recommended Action: APPROVAL - Recommendation is for approval pending the east
elevation sign clarification.

  1
 PUBLIC COMMENTS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:
Citizens wishing to address the Alhambra Design Review Board on any matter within the
subject matter jurisdiction of the Alhambra Design Review Board not on the Agenda may
do so at this time. Please STATE YOUR NAME AND ADDRESS CLEARLY for the record.

Please note that while the Alhambra Design Review Board values your comments, pursuant
to January 1, 1987 amendments of the Brown Act, the Board cannot respond nor take any
action until such time as the matter may appear as an item on a forthcoming agenda.

ADJOURNMENT:
The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Alhambra Design Review Board will be held
on Tuesday, February 25, 2020 at 7:30 p.m., in Alhambra City Hall Conference Room A,
111 South First Street, Alhambra, California.

  NOTICE:
AGENDA ITEMS: Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each
item of business described hereinabove are on file in the offices of the Community
Development Department in City Hall, 111 South First Street, Alhambra, California, and are
available for public inspection during regular office hours, which are 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.
Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any of the above
agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, he or she may contact the Community
Development Director either in person at the Department offices, or by telephone at (626)
570-5034 during regular office hours.

AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES ACT: If you require special assistance to participate in any
City meeting (including assisted listening devices) please contact the Community
Development Department at (626) 570-5034. Notification of at least 72 hours prior to the
meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this
meeting.

APPEALS: Any person wishing to appeal any decision of the Design Review Board to the
Planning Commission may do so by filing an appeal in writing along with the appropriate
appeal fee to the Community Development Department in City Hall within 10 calendar days
of the Design Review Board decision. The appeal period for items on this agenda expires at
the close of business on February 24, 2020.

  2
   Item 1

  ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  STAFF REPORT
  February 11, 2020

ADDRESS: 1501 South Raymond Avenue
APPLICANT: Nathan Gallardo
PROPERTY OWNER: Rogue Quach
PROJECT TYPE: This application is for a 120 square foot one story addition, new front
porch and exterior alterations to an existing single-family residence.
PROJECT STATUS: First Time Applicant

DESIGN ASSESSMENT: This application proposes a 120 square foot one-story addition,
new front porch and exterior alterations to an existing single-family residence. This house
was built in 1925 and is a Spanish Revival architectural style home. The addition occurs at
the front elevation, removing the existing courtyard and adding a new porch. The scope
of work includes extensive exterior alterations resulting in a Craftsman style of
architecture using details such as Hardie siding, stone wainscoting, roof shingles and gable
roof details throughout. The roof plan will be reconfigured to accommodate the addition
and a new wood trellis will be added for the new porch area. The applicant should clarify
the window types used and should consider single hungs throughout. Window details
including decorative grilles, trim and sills should be consistent with an authentic
Craftsman style. The neutral color palette and the overall design is acceptable.

RECOMMENDATION: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions:

  1. Single hung windows shall be used throughout;
  2. The window schedule and plans shall be revised to accurately reflect window
  types;
  3. Window details shall be consistent with a Craftsman style of architecture; and
  4. Revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to plan check
  submittal.
   Item 2

  ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  STAFF REPORT
  February 11, 2020

ADDRESS: 325 East Valley Boulevard
APPLICANT: Eddie Hsieh, Sign Art Co.
BUSINESS TENANT: Preferred Bank
PROPERTY OWNER: Patricia Sandoval
PROJECT TYPE: This application is for new signage to an existing commercial building for
the business known as “Preferred Bank.”
PROJECT STATUS: First Time Applicant

DESIGN ASSESSMENT: This application proposes new signage to an existing bank known
as "Preferred Bank." The existing signage will be removed and replaced with signs using
updated graphics. The proposed graphics use all caps with a similar green face, silver trim
caps and returns. Although the total sign area is larger, the new design includes more
spacing between characters and the sign band area is large enough to accommodate the
new area. The west elevation sign has a similar design but uses three lines. The copy is
smaller overall and is acceptable. The applicant should clarify if the east elevation sign will
also be replaced or removed and should be noted on the drawings.

RECOMMENDATION: Recommendation is for approval pending the east elevation sign
clarification.
